segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the July 1 start for the additional seats and make sure the invoice lines up with how finance wants to see it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re adding 18 users for the support team, so that brings us from 62 to 80 total. We need them active by July 8, but July 1 on the contract is fine.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. The pricing sheet has the 80-seat tier at $54 per user per month, billed annually. With the 18 added seats prorated from July 1 through December 31, that add-on is $5,832 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I had. Can the invoice reference cost center 4107 and the PO we issued last week, PO-28644?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, I’ll include both on the order form and the billing note. You’ll see one prorated invoice for the new seats, and then the full 80 seats will roll into the renewal invoice on January 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Also, our admin asked whether the new users can be loaded from a CSV. We don’t want to hand-key all 18.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, CSV import is included. Once the order is signed, I’ll send the onboarding checklist and we can schedule a 30-minute setup call for either July 2 or July 3.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: July 3 at 11 Eastern works. Please put Maya from my team on that invite too.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the order form today with 80 seats, July 1 effective date, PO-28644, and the cost center. If you sign by Friday, we’ll have the seats available Monday morning.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send it over and I’ll route it to our controller this afternoon.
